Author: blue704

[center][color=#ff0000][size=4][b]Please Read[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#ff0000]DO NOT update to version 1.1.5 if you are using a current save. The new update will break bundles in an in progress save. If you would like to update to the newest version, you will need to do so on a new save.[/color][/center]
[center][/center]
For all of those who love completing bundles but also enjoy the convenience of buying the Community Development Projects, here is the Joja Civic Center! As a new farmer in Pelican Town you can help JojaCo reconnect with the local populace by bringing a real sense of community to the town. No longer will there be a boring empty Community Center after all of your hard work, but instead there will be a new Civic Center where local townsfolk can open up unique stores after you stock them with items from around the valley. As each "Bundle Room" is completed, you'll also be granted access to some new areas and rewards thanks to all of your hard work.

To “build” the Civic Center you need to purchase a Joja membership. All of the vanilla requirements to purchase the membership are the same in this mod. So you need to

1. Play to at least to Spring 5. 
2. Enter town from the bus stop between 8 and 1 on a sunny day. 
3. Watch the cutscene where Lewis unlocks the CC door. 

After that the membership is available for purchase at JojaMart. Since it is 5000G I added a letter in the mail where Joja gives you 5000G as an incentive to purchase it. 

After purchasing a Joja Membership, this mod will add a  new building just south of the Warehouse/Old CC and north of Pierre's shop (It does not replace the Warehouse/Old CC. The Movie Theater will still be built in the same place as a vanilla Joja run). It also adds a total of 7 rooms to complete, each with between 5 and 8 individual bundles styled after the vanilla Community Center. Expect the difficulty to be slightly harder than vanilla especially with no planning ahead of time, but it can be completed in one year without needing to rely on RNG. The bundles encourage variety and you may even have to build a few buildings or take part in a few activities that you've never been a part of before to complete them! Bundles and requirements are listed below.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/236691548-1780658167.png[/img]

As of version 1.1.5 there are several new config options that should be selected [color=#ffff00][b]BEFORE[/b][/color] a new save is started. Bundle options selected after a save is started will not take effect. The Alternate Fish Farm option can be toggled during gameplay but will cause some errors (all of which can be fixed fairly easily if you decide you really need the alternate location after starting a save).

[b][color=#00ff00]Bundle Base[/color][/b]
Select which expansion (or Vanilla if you have no expansions installed) you would like to be featured in the Civic Center bundles. If you have more than one expansion installed, choose whichever one you would like as the foundation for you bundles. If there's demand for multiple expansions to be featured at the same time, I could add more options in the future.

[b][color=#00ff00]Bundle Addons[/color][/b]
Enable More Difficult Bundles for a more challenging experience. I opted to use items that are harder to obtain instead of just requiring you to grind 40 parsnips or something like that. For example, the harder Fish Farmer bundle requires Glacierfish Roe and Aged Legend Roe.

Enable Cornucopia Bundles if you would like to use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url]. Requires "Enable Extended Crops Pack" to be toggled true in the Cornucopia config. This will also have different variations if you have More Difficult Bundles enabled as well.

[b][color=#00ff00]Alternate Fish Farm Location[/color][/b]
When selected to true it will place the Fish Farm in a unique area to the east of the vanilla tide pools. I included this since there are cutscenes from RSV that conflict with the Fish Farm placement, but it can be used if you have another mod that alters the vanilla tide pool area. I strongly recommend that you set this option when starting a new save for the best results. However, you can change it mid save but be prepared to destroy the old buildings before changing the option.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/236691548-1775668995.png[/img]
The Civic Center's pantry is empty and needs you to collect a lot of produce to fill it. Upon completion not only will you gain access to a new cellar inside the Civic Center, but everyone's favorite grandmother, Evelyn will open up a shop in the Civic Center's kitchen. In her new shop she will sell you different food items each day, random recipes, and a small chance to acquire the Queen of Sauce cookbook. And most importantly she'll let you have a free cookie everyday that you stop by.

[color=#ffff00][b]Can I add this to an existing Stardew Valley save?[/b][/color]
[color=#efefef]As long as you haven't completed the Community Center you should be able to add this mod without issues.[/color]

[color=#ffff00][b]Why is there a Cabin on my farm when I didn't select multiplayer during the initial setup?[/b][/color]
[color=#efefef]As far as I can tell this is a bug with the Buildings Included framework that I used to add buildings to the new areas. I've messaged the creator of that mod but haven't gotten a response yet. So you can enjoy your free cabin (extra keg space!), or you can demolish it at Robin's as well. If you happen to know of another way that I can add buildings to new areas, please let me know.[/color]

[color=#ffff00][b]I found a Treasure Hunt Tag but I can't add it to the Treasure Hunt Bundles in the Civic Center.[/b][/color]
[color=#efefef]When you find a Treasure Hunt Tag it goes into your Wallet like Golden Walnuts. I did it this way because I didn't want someone to find a tag but then be unable to put it in their inventory because they had no space. However, this means you don't have a physical item to place in the bundle, but if you move your cursor over the Treasure Hunt Tag image (below the picture of Jas and Vincent) inside the bundle screen you can click that image and it will take one tag from your Wallet to complete the bundle.[/color]

[color=#ffff00][b]How do I purchase the Vault bundles?[/b][/color]
[color=#efefef]Same as the Treasure Hunt Tag above. Just move your cursor over the image of the stack of coins and select that to deduct the funds from your Wallet and purchase the bundle.[/color]
